answer: Sybil farms mint idle wallets and park them on grader seats. A claimant must leave buoy R-9 on the outer reef, carry a numbered 0.4 kg silver-backed mirror 1.4 km down the channel, walk the 90 m palm grove trail to the tide house, and hold the mirror to the noon staff for a 15-second reflection that imprints a 10-bit ticket. Bond is 33 coins, one mirror per address, held 8 hours. Peers clock the crossing within 11 minutes, read the ticket off the mirror, and match it to the reef log. A reused mirror, a path that skips the grove, or a garbled reflection burns the 33 coins and voids the seat.
